# Wellstar Polyclinic & Diagnostic Centre

> Multispecialty clinic, diagnostic lab and pharmacy in Hebbal, Bengaluru, India. Specialist consultations, doctor-curated health packages (from ₹999) with home sample collection, and medicine delivery within 2 km. Booking is by WhatsApp or phone.

- Address: 45/2, 8th A Cross Rd, Kanaka Nagar, Hebbal, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560045, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 63620 64109 · Pharmacy delivery: +91 63637 78957
- Email: frontdesk@wellstar.in
- Hours (IST): Monday–Saturday 8:00 AM–10:00 PM; Sunday 8:00 AM–1:00 PM
- In a medical emergency, call 108 or go to the nearest hospital emergency department.
